recognize_zh: 骨髓抽吸抹片中，大型不典型淋巴樣細胞核不規則、有凹陷，細胞質深藍色，左上方那顆含許多小空泡；它們夾雜在細胞質帶粉紅顆粒、核呈腎形的骨髓性前驅細胞之間，體積明顯較大、細胞質更嗜鹼，符合 ATLL 侵犯骨髓的多形表現。
features: Large atypical lymphoid cells with irregular, indented to lobulated nuclei and moderately condensed chromatin
Moderate deeply basophilic cytoplasm; one cell (upper left) with numerous small clear cytoplasmic vacuoles
Occasional small nucleoli; no well-developed flower-cell morphology
Admixed residual myeloid precursors (metamyelocytes/bands with pink granular cytoplasm and kidney-shaped nuclei) for comparison
Hemodilute proteinaceous background with scattered red cells and platelets
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows large atypical lymphoid cells admixed with residual granulocytic precursors. The atypical cells have irregular, indented to lobulated nuclei with moderately condensed chromatin and occasional nucleoli, and a moderate amount of deeply basophilic cytoplasm; one cell contains numerous small clear vacuoles. Classic clover-leaf (flower) nuclei are not evident, and the vacuolated basophilic morphology overlaps with anaplastic large cell lymphoma and plasmablastic cells. With a CD3+/CD4+ phenotype and complete loss of CD5, findings are consistent with marrow involvement by a mature T-cell neoplasm compatible with adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma, pending confirmation of HTLV-1 infection.

ddx.vs: ALCL shows hallmark horseshoe-shaped nuclei and strong uniform CD30, often ALK+, whereas ATLL is typically CD25+ and HTLV-1 associated.
Plasmablasts have eccentric round nuclei with a prominent single nucleolus and perinuclear hof and are CD138+/MUM1+ without CD3.
Burkitt cells are monotonous medium-sized cells with round nuclei and deeply basophilic vacuolated cytoplasm and a CD10+ B-cell phenotype with MYC rearrangement.
Monoblasts have fine chromatin with gray-blue cytoplasm and are CD64/CD14 and nonspecific esterase positive rather than CD3+.
